text:
[Council File 26-1347]
Motion (Harris-Dawson – Jurado) relative to actions and resources required to implement interim facility bed matching for City funded interim beds if there is a dissolution of the Los Angeles Homelessness Services Authority and a split between the City and the County.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Homelessness and Health Committee action: Approved as Amended: ADOPTED Motion (Harris-Dawson – Jurado) dated September 22, 2026 AS AMENDED BY Motion (Jurado - Padilla) (Nov 10, 2026); Council action: Adopted (Nov 18, 2026)

summary: Council motion on the actions and funding needed to keep City-funded interim beds matched with people if the Los Angeles Homelessness Services Authority is dissolved and split between the City and County. The Homelessness and Health Committee approved it as amended.
